pain.headline: Your inbox is leaking orders.
pain.body: Most f-commerce sellers do not lose customers because the product is bad. They lose customers because replies are late, inventory lives in sheets, and order details get copied between tabs all day.

items.title: Repeated questions
items.body: Customers ask price, size, stock, delivery time, and return policy again and again.

items.title: Manual order taking
items.body: Phone, address, item, quantity, courier, and COD amount are collected by hand.

items.title: Sheet-based inventory
items.body: Products and stock already live in Google Sheets or Excel, but the inbox does not know that.

items.title: Courier copy-paste
items.body: Pathao, RedX, Steadfast, and payment workflows become separate admin work after every sale.

setup.headline: From page to selling bot without a rebuild.
setup.body: Coelor is designed around how Bangladesh f-commerce teams already work: social pages, spreadsheets, COD, local couriers, and fast inbox conversations.

steps.title: Connect your page
steps.body: Connect Facebook Messenger first, then WhatsApp and Instagram as channels are enabled. No customer-facing password sharing.

steps.title: Import your products
steps.body: Bring your existing catalog from Google Sheets, Excel, CSV, or a page/catalog source so the bot knows stock, price, images, and variants.

steps.title: Add courier and payment keys
steps.body: Paste Pathao, Steadfast, RedX, SSLCommerz, and COD settings once. Coelor uses them when orders are created.

steps.title: Turn on the AI sales agent
steps.body: The bot answers in Bangla/Banglish, shows products, collects order info, and hands off to your team when needed.

features.headline: The bot is the salesperson. The dashboard is the control room.
features.body: Coelor combines social commerce automation with the operational tools a real seller needs after the customer says yes.

items.title: Bangla/Banglish AI sales bot
items.body: Understands mixed Bangla, romanized Bangla, and English for product search, stock questions, variants, cart, and checkout.

items.title: Product-aware conversations
items.body: The bot can show categories, product cards, variants, prices, stock, and similar products from the merchant catalog.

items.title: Auto order collection
items.body: Collects phone, delivery address, quantity, and payment preference from chat, then creates a real order.

items.title: Human takeover inbox
items.body: Admins can read conversations, send replies, pause the bot per customer, and keep support inside one live view.

items.title: Courier and payment workflow
items.body: Designed for Pathao, Steadfast, RedX, COD, and SSLCommerz so confirmed orders can move into fulfillment quickly.

items.title: Sheet-first inventory
items.body: Built for sellers who already manage products in Google Sheets or Excel, not only teams with a perfect ecommerce backend.

faq.headline: Questions sellers ask before switching on the bot.

items.q: Do I need an ecommerce website first?
items.a: No. Coelor is designed for f-commerce sellers who sell from social inboxes. A storefront can exist, but the bot and catalog can run the sales flow.

items.q: Can I use my existing Google Sheet or Excel file?
items.a: Yes. The product direction is sheet-first: import products, stock, price, images, and variants from the files sellers already maintain.

items.q: Does it understand Bangla and Banglish?
items.a: Yes. The bot is designed for Bangla, romanized Bangla, English, and mixed customer messages.
Yes. Admins can pause the bot for a conversation and reply from the dashboard.

items.q: Which couriers and payments are planned for setup?
items.a: Pathao, Steadfast, RedX, COD, and SSLCommerz are the core BD workflow targets.
